destinations.name: Nzulezo Stilt Village
destinations.description: Unique village built entirely on stilts on Lake Tadane. The entire community lives on wooden platforms above the water, accessed only by canoe. A UNESCO tentative world heritage site and one of Ghana's most unusual attractions.
highlights: Entire village on stilts above water
destinations.entry_fee: Canoe tour GHS 100-150 per person (includes guide)
destinations.accessibility: Requires 45-minute canoe trip, moderate fitness needed
destinations.location_details: Near Beyin, Western Region. 90km west of Takoradi. Canoe departure from Beyin.

destinations.name: Ankasa Conservation Area
destinations.description: Pristine tropical rainforest reserve with diverse wildlife including forest elephants, bongo antelopes, and over 190 bird species. One of Ghana's most biodiverse protected areas with ancient rainforest.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: November to March (dry season for wildlife viewing)
destinations.entry_fee: GHS 40 for adults, GHS 20 for students (guide required)
destinations.location_details: Near Elubo, Western Region. 3 hours from Takoradi. 4x4 vehicle recommended.

destinations.name: Axim Beach
destinations.description: Beautiful, relatively quiet beach town with historic Fort St. Antonio and pristine beaches. Less crowded than Busua, offering a more relaxed beach experience with historical significance.
destinations.best_time_to_visit: November to March, but year-round destination
destinations.entry_fee: Free beach access, fort entry GHS 10
destinations.accessibility: Easy beach access, accessible by car
destinations.location_details: Axim town, Western Region. 65km west of Takoradi on coastal road.

destinations.name: Princess Town and Fort Gross Friedrichsburg
destinations.description: Historic coastal town with Brandenburg Fort Gross Friedrichsburg, originally built by Germans in the 17th century. Quiet beach town with significant colonial history.
destinations.accessibility: Accessible by car, 30km west of Takoradi
destinations.location_details: Princess Town (Pokesu), Western Region. Between Takoradi and Busua.

destinations.name: Takoradi Market Circle
destinations.description: Bustling commercial hub and market in Ghana's oil city. Vibrant atmosphere with diverse goods, local food, and authentic urban Ghanaian experience. Gateway to Western Region attractions.
destinations.location_details: Central Takoradi, Western Region. Major transport hub for Western Region exploration.

accommodations.name: Lou Moon Lodge
accommodations.description: Popular beachfront lodge in Busua with stunning ocean views. Comfortable rooms, good food, and direct beach access. Favorite among surfers and beach lovers.
accommodations.additional_info: Perfect for surfers and beach relaxation. Popular with travelers.

accommodations.name: Axim Beach Resort
accommodations.description: Beachfront resort offering comfortable accommodations with ocean views. Quieter alternative to busier beach towns, with good facilities and friendly service.
accommodations.additional_info: Peaceful beach location, good for relaxation away from crowds.

accommodations.name: Rainforest Lodge Ankasa
accommodations.description: Basic eco-lodge near Ankasa Conservation Area. Simple accommodations in the heart of the rainforest, perfect for nature enthusiasts and birdwatchers.
accommodations.additional_info: Best for eco-tourists and nature lovers. Book rainforest tours through lodge.

accommodations.name: Planters Lodge Takoradi
accommodations.description: Well-established hotel in Takoradi with comfortable rooms and good business facilities. Popular with oil industry workers and tourists exploring the Western Region.
accommodations.additional_info: Good base for exploring Western Region beaches and attractions.
